fences.rule: A trade is here only if the carrier changes where the power is found and for whose account it is exercised, so third parties route to the taker; an agency in which the power keeps its address and the agent acts for the principal's account is out, and Blame-bearer's fee is in only because the registry, Rented door's carrier, moves the address.
fences.case: A client gives counsel a power of attorney and receives service, but the courts and every third party still route to the client and the client pays rather than receives.

fences.rule: The chip invented to break a deadlock, the swap of vetoes or the right of first refusal, is there; what becomes of the power once traded, the shape of its rate and the moment it is found one-sided, is here and presupposes the chip.
fences.case: A right to match the next round is written as an option and paid as a chill, since outsiders will not spend a month of diligence on a round they can be matched out of.

fences.rule: An obsolete power still obeyed by habit is there; a live power leased away and atrophied by disuse, which an employer that tests it may find still works, is here.
fences.case: The strike threat of a union in a plant already automated.

fences.rule: One standing converting into another in the same holder is there; a share of decisions passing to a counterparty for a sign whose worth third parties settle afterward is here.
fences.case: A founder gives the chief executive's chair and receives the chairman's, and learns which kind of sign it is on the day the meetings move elsewhere.

fences.rule: The same class veto: here it is priced at signing by the founder's estimate of an improbability against a buyer who knows the base rate; there it is valued at the moment of exercise by what the blocked party's speed is worth.
fences.case: A seed class holds up a rescue round with three weeks of runway for a better conversion until the round dies.

fences.rule: The same dual-class charter: here the public's vote is traded for a discounted share and the founder's ten votes cannot be sold onward, only held; there the same ten votes are control on a clock of sunset and transfer events the founder never read.
fences.case: A divorce transfers a two-point block of the founder's class, which converts on transfer, and the vote falls under half.
